identity.title: [v0.92.1][C-SDLC] Fail closed on stale owner binaries before primary-checkout mutation

values.task_boundary: Implement one shared pre-mutation installed-owner provenance gate, atomic generation verification, and focused primary-checkout safety proof.
deliverables: Focused owner/install validation evidence and exact-head review
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every installed owner capable of repository mutation invokes the shared provenance gate before its first mutation
AC-2: Stale, missing, malformed, partial, or digest-mismatched installations fail closed with no target-checkout change
AC-3: A current owner still rejects bootstrap on primary main and succeeds in an allowed isolated FastWork checkout
AC-4: Freshness detects owner-source drift without treating unrelated repository commits as stale
AC-5: Installation publishes only a complete verified generation and receipt atomically
AC-6: Existing residue is reported without deletion and diagnostics are portable and credential-free
AC-7: Focused tests, owner validation, install/resolve contracts, diff hygiene, and exact-head review pass
dependencies: #548 primary-checkout bootstrap guard merged into current main
non_goals: Making closeout or cleanup an execution dependency
